answer: Require every new agent to burn a deposit before it can transact, so a thousand fake personas cost real capital instead of keystrokes. Then cluster wallets by funding source and signup timing: a sybil farm looks like one marble slab stamped by a single hand, while honest agents scatter like saffron threads across separate markets. The operator watches for bursts, and any cluster that fails the test is frozen under basalt-hard rules until it proves independence.
